periods.time: Final night of the joint training camp

name.zh: 艾莉丝与珠雫的最后一杯酒
name.en: Alice and Shizuku share a last drink

periods.summary: After hiding Kagami, Alice returns to his shared room with Shizuku and invites her to drink from his old green bottle. Shizuku realizes this is a special night for Alice because he has never reached out for his own sake before. Alice explains the childhood 'adult ritual' tied to the bottle, watches Shizuku fall asleep, and remembers the orphan tragedy that led him to Rebellion.
periods.cause: Alice believes the next day will end his life at Hagun and wants one final private moment with Shizuku.
periods.outcome: Shizuku's insight reinforces that she sees Alice as her sister; Alice's old vow and trauma are brought to the surface before his defection decision.
periods.significance: Emotional pivot that clarifies why Alice later cannot destroy Shizuku's hopes.
